rule_value: First year B.E./B.Tech degree courses
notes: TNEA 2026 Unified Single Window Admission System

rule_value: Candidates who have passed VIII, IX, X, XI and XII in schools situated in Tamil Nadu are eligible
notes: No Nativity Certificate required for this category

rule_name: Tamil Nadu native studied outside Tamil Nadu
rule_value: Tamil Nadu native candidates who studied any of VIII to XII outside Tamil Nadu can apply
notes: Nativity Certificate required in electronic/digitally signed e-Certificate form

rule_value: Children of Central Government Employees can apply if parent/guardian has served continuously in Tamil Nadu for five years at application time
notes: Employer certificate required

rule_name: Public sector or recognised institution employee child
rule_value: Children of employees in Public Sector or Government recognised Institutions can apply if employed continuously in Tamil Nadu for five years
notes: Employer and supporting employment/income evidence required

rule_name: Other State candidate studied in Tamil Nadu
rule_value: Other State candidates who studied VIII, IX, X, XI and XII in Tamil Nadu are eligible
notes: No Nativity Certificate required

rule_value: Passed HSC (Academic) or equivalent with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry as subjects
notes: Verify exact minimum marks and subject conditions from the official eligibility section

rule_value: Passed HSC (Vocational) or equivalent with relevant prescribed subjects
notes: Vocational eligibility has additional subject conditions; retain as a separate rule

rule_value: Marks in prescribed subjects are reduced to 200: Mathematics 100, Physics 50, Chemistry 50
notes: This is the merit calculation, not the minimum eligibility requirement

rule_value: Marks from different qualifying examination boards are normalised for common merit ranking
notes: Normalised marks are not used for minimum eligibility

rule_name: All India Service Tamil Nadu cadre child
rule_value: Sons and daughters of All India Service Tamil Nadu cadre officers are eligible to apply
notes: Self-declaration from the parent is required

rule_value: Sri Lankan Tamil Refugees who studied in Tamil Nadu will be considered under Open Competition
notes: Identification certificate and additional documents are required as specified

rule_value: OCI/PIO cardholders who are natives of Tamil Nadu are permitted to participate in Tamil Nadu Engineering Counselling under Open Category
notes: Provision applicable from academic year 2023-24 onwards

rule_value: Categories (iii) to (vi) under Nativity are considered under Open Competition
notes: Includes Central Government employee children, Public Sector/Government recognised institution employee children, All India Service Tamil Nadu cadre children, and Other State candidates studied in Tamil Nadu

rule_value: Applications without required Nativity Certificate, employer certificate, or parent self-declaration as applicable will not be considered
notes: Category (vi) does not require employer or Nativity Certificate
